title: Release choreography & observation sandbox (wip)
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a lightweight working sandbox for defining a cross-team choreography and observation pattern for canaries and A/B slices of LLM-powered features. Focus is on coordination, signal hygiene, and pragmatic fallbacks for interdependent services (hosting + reranker + user-features).

Goals:
- Create a minimal ceremony that reduces friction for product + SRE + model ops during phased exposure.
- Define a compact signal set (SLO, safety, quality, cost) that we can compute for any slice in <15m.
- Provide an activation cadence template teams can copy (timing, owners, roll/rollback triggers).

Quick summary of recommended cadence (starter):
1) Preflight (T-72h): smoke plan, baseline telemetry snapshot, sandbox synthetic suite. Owners: product + test eng.
2) Dry-run (T-24h): dry-run routing to canary infra (0% user traffic). Validate end-to-end traces, quotas, rate limits. Owners: eng + infra.
3) Micro-exposure (T+0 start): 0.5% user traffic or 1k requests/day (whichever hits first) for 2h. Observe.
4) Ramp phases: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 25% over 24–72h with checkpoints at each step.
5) Hold & evaluate: run automated evaluation sets and manual review at each checkpoint.

Core signal set (compute every minute for the slice):
- Latency P99, P95, mean (in-region and cross-region)
- Error rate (4xx/5xx) and model-fallback-rate (how often fallback model was used)
- Cost per token and tokens/s consumed vs expected
- Quality delta: automated eval BLEU/ROUGE-like metric for prompt set + production feedback signals (explicit thumbs-down rate)
- Safety triggers: rate of policy violations, sandboxed flag hits, moderation escalations
- User impact proxy: engagement drop / conversion delta vs baseline cohort

Gating rules (starter heuristics):
- Immediate rollback if: 5xx error rate > baseline + 1.5% absolute AND sustained >5 minutes OR safety trigger > 0.1% of requests in 10m window
- Pause ramp if: latency P95 increased by >2x baseline for the slice OR cost per token > 1.8x expected and conversion drop > 3%
- Auto-fallback: on model instability, route to smaller/cheaper variant for 10 minutes while alerting.

Cross-team responsibilities (minimum):
- Product owner: hypothesis, user-impact acceptance criteria, stakeholder comms
- Eng lead: rollout config, canary slice selection, guardrail implementation
- SRE/Infra: synthetic traffic generation, tracing hooks, oncall escalation playbook
- Model Ops: model variants, quantization profiles, fallback mappings
- Observability: dashboard ownership, alert tuning, evaluation hooks

Observability templates to include in the console:
- Slice dashboard: top-line signals, cohort trends, heatmap of signal deltas over baseline
- Signal drill: per-request trace with model variant and KV-cache hit annotation
- Experiment timeline: automated notes of when traffic changed, config diff, commits involved

Activation choreography examples (copyable):
- Small feature (UI prompt rewording): prereq smoke + 4h micro-exposure -> 12h ramp to 10% -> hold 24h -> full.
- Heavy model change (decoder rewrite/large quantization): prereq infra dry-run + 48h micro-exposure -> staged scaling with synthetic stress tests at each stage.

Safety & compliance considerations (notes):
- For Private/Dedicated customers, ensure model variant mapping includes approved enterprise variants and KMS audit traceability before any exposure.
- If regulatory cohort detected, route to private variant by default and mark slice as excluded from public canaries.

Testing harness and synthetic traffic notes:
- Small corpus of deterministic prompts for regression checks (50 prompts covering safety, hallucination, formatting). Run at each checkpoint; fail fast on >3 regressions.
- Stress profiles: per-region concurrency profile that matches 95th percentile real traffic; run prior to 10% ramp.

Open questions / TODOs:
- How to codify user-impact proxy for non-monetized endpoints? (Samira own)
- Need a standard TTL for slice dashboards and trace retention for canaries (cost vs forensic value)
- Decide canonical ticket label for rollout tasks (JIRA vs Linear) — quick poll scheduled.

Notes to self (rough):
- Integrate with Redwood Optimize recommendations: use suggested batching and quantization knob as part of preflight checks.
- Build a tiny 'safe-mode' API route that flips traffic to fallback across all services with one API call.

Appendix: small checklist for runbook card (to paste into console)
- [ ] Hypothesis + owner + start time
- [ ] Canary slice definition + sampling rule
- [ ] Synthetic suite run results attached
- [ ] Dashboards linked + alert thresholds documented
- [ ] Communication plan (who to ping on Slack + oncall)
- [ ] Roll/rollback play with postmortem owner assigned

References and links: see linked_artifacts above.

Last edited notes: still need to align with SRE on exact alarm windows and create a small demo run with the micro-exposure cadence next sprint.

----
Edits: 2026-03-01 — switched immediate rollback latency rule from P99 to P95 after infra feedback (P99 too noisy for short slices).
